articles.headline: Form SCHEDULE 13G/A Hub Cyber Security Ltd. Filed by: Wang Andre
articles.summary: Andre Wang's amended disclosure reports beneficial ownership of 200,000 Hub Cyber shares. The May 18 event date differs from its May 28 publication; the filing is not a real-time purchase report or proof of issuer capital raising.
articles.timestampEvidence: Full filing reproduction explicitly May 28, 2026 10:48 AM EDT, identifies issuer/filer and reports the ownership position.
